LightningComponentBundle.description: Displays a dynamic visual alert message with custom type and text on record pages.

property.name: message
property.label: Alert Message Text
property.default: Please enter your alert message here
property.description: The main text displayed in the alert.

property.name: type
property.label: Alert Type (Color/Icon)
property.description: Controls the visual style and icon of the alert (Red, Yellow, Green, Gray/Info).
